It also evokes the ultimate sacrifice of Christ, the Lamb of God, who gave His life for our redemption.
32.commentaire: This passage teaches us the importance of consecration in our relationship with God. By offering our 'best' to God, we acknowledge His sovereignty and goodness. Whether through our actions, words, or thoughts, we are called to live a life of devotion that honors God and bears witness to our faith.

By offering our lives as living sacrifices, we imitate the example of the sin offering goat, recognizing that Christ is our ultimate sacrifice for our sins.
